task_description: Build a complete React Native Expo weather mobile application from scratch with modern clean UI, multiple screens (Home, Forecast, Locations, Settings), weather data from multiple locations, and security best practices. No user authentication - just weather viewing.

verification.summary: Build and test commands require npm install which is blocked by INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Verification performed via: file existence check (43 source files present), syntax review of key files (valid TypeScript/TSX), cross-file import consistency check (all imports reference existing files with correct paths), architecture review (proper React patterns, context/reducer state management, service layer separation). All features completed successfully.
